questionnaire.name: Halvorsen Grid for Accounts Payable Automation, 2027: pre-qualification survey

answers.question: How many customers use your product for accounts payable automation? Give the count by region.
answers.answer: 410 customers use Northpine for accounts payable automation as of 2026-09-30: 372 in North America and 38 in EMEA.

answers.question: What was your annual recurring revenue at the end of your last fiscal quarter?
answers.answer: $24.0M annual recurring revenue at 2026-09-30, the end of our last fiscal quarter.

answers.question: Describe your native e-invoicing coverage by country.
answers.answer: Native e-invoicing is live today in {{countries with native e-invoicing live today}}. On our roadmap, native e-invoicing in Germany and France is planned for 2027-06; it is not available today.
answers.who_supplies: Product team: the countries live today

answers.question: What share of your customers are outside your home region?
answers.answer: 9.3% (38 of 410) at 2026-09-30, below 10%. We started an EMEA sales and support team in 2026-09 with a target of 50 EMEA customers by 2027-03-31.

answers.question: Provide three customer references for the evaluation.
answers.answer: Two customers have agreed to speak: {{reference 1}} and {{reference 2}}. A third, {{reference 3}}, is pending their approval.
answers.who_supplies: Customer success: names, contacts and the third approval

answers.question: What percentage of invoices are processed without manual touch?
answers.answer: 71% of invoices were processed with no manual touch from July to September 2026.
